html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · May 27, 2022

On Nov 23, 2021, global influencer marketing tech platform LTK (Dallas HQ; offices in NY/LA/London/Paris/Shanghai/Seoul…) closed a $300M round from SoftBank Vision Fund at a $2B valuation — 3rd round (seed Apr’12, A Jan’15). Creator enablement + brand influencer campaigns with measurement + own social-commerce layer; platform GMV ~$30B/yr. China presence since 2012 for fashion/trend and brand go-global via global creators. Proceeds: talent, tech, creator/brand/consumer experience.

— END —
